accessKeyHelp: If set, the app asks for this key once per device
shoppingAddItemIdHelp: The item name is written to this state with ack=false
shoppingContentId: State that contains the current list (optional)
shoppingContentIdHelp: JSON array of objects with a name; used to avoid duplicates and to show the shopping cart markers
bringListIdHelp: Choose the Bring! list (found automatically) or type the channel id, e.g. bring.0.<list-id>
modeBringSpecial: Bring! special (adds quantities to an existing item)
removeOnRestock: Remove from the list when the stock is refilled
removeOnRestockHelp: Takes the item off the Bring! list when the stock rises above the minimum again
shoppingRemoveItemId: State that receives items to remove (optional)
shoppingRemoveItemIdHelp: The item name is written to this state with ack=false. Enables removing via the cart tick in the app and the option below
removeOnUncheck: Remove from the list when I untick the check mark in the app
removeOnUncheckHelp: Tapping the check mark in the app also takes the item off the list
bestBeforeModeHelp: Off: not used. Per product: one date on each product. Per stocking: a date for every booking of stock, the oldest is used first when removing.
bestBeforeWarnDaysHelp: Products expiring within this period are marked and listed in the data points
createCertHelp: Creates a certificate for this host (host name and IP addresses), stores it in the ioBroker certificates and selects it. Install it on your devices via the .cer download.
notifyAdapterHelp: Installed instances such as telegram, telegrammenu2, pushover, signal, whatsapp, matrix or email. Empty = no notifications
notifyTargetHelp: Chat ID for telegram, e-mail address for email. Empty = default recipient of the adapter
notifyAreaHelp: Must be an area that is already approved in telegrammenu2
notifyLow: Message when the minimum stock is reached
notifyExpiry: Daily message about expired and expiring products
labelButtonsHelp: Choose which label buttons the app shows, so it stays as short as you like
notifyInventoryDays: Remind once about a stocktaking after … days without one (0 = off)
scannerTimeoutHelp: After a product scan the location code has to follow within this time. Two scans of the product mean take out. Switch the mode on with the data point scanner.active.
scannerDeviceHelp: The dongle of the wireless scanner appears here as a keyboard. The ioBroker user needs the group "input" (adduser iobroker input).
scannerLayoutHelp: Must match the layout set on the scanner. US is the factory setting. With German, umlauts and ß are read as well.
autoShelfModeHelp: Whether a best-before date is entered automatically from the default shelf life of the product when stocking in without a date (own value, group value or the built-in suggestion for dry goods). Products without a default shelf life, such as fresh goods, get no date. "Always": in the app too. "Only without the app": only in scanner mode and via data points, where nobody can type a date; in the app the date stays empty. "Never" also stops the suggestions for dry goods.
asHeadless: Only without the app (scanner mode, data points)
autoShelfScopeHelp: "Only dry goods" ignores own and group values here: they are not entered automatically, only the suggestions for pasta, rice, tins and similar.
scAll: Everything with a standard shelf life
scDry: Only dry goods from the built-in list
dateFormatHelp: Format of all dates in the web app, for example the best-before date.
checkAddMissing: Put missing ingredients on the shopping list
checkAddMissingHelp: After every check of check.request, the ingredients that are missing or not enough are put on the shopping list. Switch it off to only get the result and use the datapoint check.addMissing when you want them on the list.
notifySoonTitle: Heading for products expiring soon (empty = default)
notifySoonTitleHelp: For example: Use these up soon:
shoppingQuantity: Write the missing amount to the list
shoppingQuantityHelp: Writes how many are missing (minimum minus stock), e.g. "Flour, 2". If the stock drops further, only the difference is added. Bring! Special adds up on the list; in script mode your script gets "Name, amount" every time and has to add up itself
listByGroup: Write the group name to the shopping list
listByGroupHelp: If a product belongs to a group, the group name goes on the list, e.g. "Flour" instead of "Flour 405". Switched off, the first product of the group that is empty is used (otherwise the first by name). Products without a group always go on the list with their own name.
webLookup: Allow web search for unknown products
webLookupHelp: Adds a button to the product editor that searches the web for the barcode when no product database knows it (DuckDuckGo and the shop pages it finds). Only runs when you tap the button; only the barcode is sent.
eanSearchTokenHelp: Free access token of ean-search.org (register on ean-search.org). With it, the web search asks the official interface and is no longer blocked after a few lookups.
openGtinKeyHelp: Free query ID of opengtindb.org (register there, in the profile). With it, the web search also asks the Open EAN / GTIN database for the name.
scanWindowHelp: From the third scan on, each further scan of the same product must follow within this time, otherwise counting starts over (1 to 30, default 3).
scanModeHelp: Standard: product, then location; scanning twice takes out. Scans = quantity: every scan stocks in one piece, three scans are three pieces. Taking out then works with the code SM:OUT.
scanDefaultLocationHelp: Used for products that have not been stocked in anywhere yet. Otherwise the last location of the product counts.
scanRulesHelp: Scanning a product once waits for a location, twice takes it out. From three scans on you choose the action here. Each number of scans can be used once.
scanAct_stockLast: Stock in at the last known location
scanAct_stockQty: Stock in several at the last location (value = quantity, otherwise the number of scans)
scanAct_shopAdd: Put on the shopping list (value = quantity)
notifyDays: Message on these days before the date (e.g. 7,4,3,2,1,0)
notifyDaysHelp: Comma separated days before the best-before date on which a message is sent, e.g. 7,4,3,2,1,0. 0 = on the day, -1 = one day after. Empty = a message every day within the warning period.
freezeDefaultDaysHelp: For products without their own frozen shelf life, stocked into a freezer location. 0 = no automatic date for frozen goods.
checkNotifySkipped: Report ingredients that were not put on the list
checkNotifySkippedHelp: Sends a message through the selected notification adapter, listing the ingredients that were not put on the shopping list because they are in stock, with the product names that were counted.
ownDbModeHelp: Asked first when a barcode is scanned or entered. The data point ownDb.data is always part of it: put your database there, products with own barcodes are added to it automatically.
ownDbFileHelp: Full path, e.g. /opt/iobroker/shelfmate/products.csv or a mounted network drive. Read only.
ownDbUrlHelp: http or https, e.g. http://192.168.1.20/products.json. Loaded again after the refresh time.
ownDbFormat: Format of data point, file and web address
ofObject: JSON object with barcodes as keys
ownDbMapHelp: Only needed for data point, file and web address of these settings, where the names differ from ShelfMate (for example "Krömpel" for the name). Dots reach into nested data (data.title). Not listed fields keep their ShelfMate name. The data point ownDb.data always uses the ShelfMate names.
